asks: Does a subscription sign-in change how Silo reads traffic?
answer: No. A subscription and an API key are read the same way, whatever credential the request carries. A sign-in can change the host and the transport, though. Codex under a ChatGPT sign-in talks to chatgpt.com, and with an API key to api.openai.com. So the hosts Silo reads and their formats are listed per provider and per kind of sign-in, and a live check covers each pair before Silo reads it. Model traffic to a host that is not on the list, such as a host a new version of a program starts to use, is not read, and Silo treats it as `program-that-cannot-be-read` says. The live check of each version a recipe pins, in `reading-each-agent-program`, is where such a host is found and added to the list.
